rows.en:
I couldn't say…

It goes without saying that we'll do our best, but… The assault team must be fighting desperately too, right? We also need to hurry with the lead barrier…
[HERO2]… Don't give me any more trouble!
Gaaooooooh!!

…!?

Satoru…? This thing is Satoru's EATER… What a horrible form…

…!?

Satoru…? This thing is Satoru's EATER… What a horrible form…

[HERO2]! Run!

With our power… we can't put a single scratch on Satoru's EATER!
Satoru…

Kaori!!

Damn it, I can't do it! I can't attack Satoru…!
EATER Test Subject 004…
…!? Who are you…?
Steel Emperor Zephas…!?

EATER Test Subject 004…

You've done well to come this far… But neither this Space Fortress Naager nor the evolution of the Vol can be stopped!

Soon you will all be ruled by the Vol, and fade away…

However…

I, too… have not been completely ruled by the Vol. I still possess plenty of human heart…
How dare you say that…
How dare you say that…

Heh heh heh…

As proof of that, I have prepared a very special Christmas present for you…
A Christmas present…?
A Christmas present…?
On this holy night, it is the finest present of all!
Accept it!
This ringtone is…!?
This ringtone is…!?
No way…!? [HERO4]… is that you?
No way…!? [HERO4]… is that you?

Behold!

The virgin has conceived… And she bore an EATER, and named it… "Velvet Fury"…

Tonight, the two of you… may speak of love to your hearts' content!

Volfeed! Intruders have broken into my castle… Apfaron is having a hard fight! Eliminate them at once!

Damn it… How dare you turn [HERO4] into something like this…!?

I won't forgive you! I'll never forgive you!!

Damn it… How dare you turn [HERO4] into something like this…!?

I won't forgive you! I'll never forgive you!!

Coming on a night of falling stars, the fairy of sorrow plays among the trees of the forest…

The shooting star of misfortune wishes! That she compete with the blue fairy and win… Oh, what a merry, lively night it will be!
What are you saying? Are you really [HERO4]?
What are you saying? Are you really [HERO4]?

"Won't the journey to defeat the Steel Emperor ever end? Just one more step… and I can be with him?

But when the journey is over… what will you do? Will you leave me behind and go away again? If so, then I…"

"Fairy… If there is a stain, that part must be cut away…

Because… that part is the part bewitched by evil…

What I dreamed of was a little happiness.

What I wished for was a single love…"

"Is this feeling a sin? A destiny I must defeat. A person I have to kill…

Somewhere, I hear a voice. 'I can't kill him…' Is that my voice?

Since when did I start lying to my heart? I lied about my feelings and followed after him. No matter how much I chase him, no matter how much… he never turns around to look at me…

Is this feeling a sin? Letting my thoughts run to him…"

"Why?

Because I can't kill him…

What did I keep traveling for?

Because I wanted to be by his side…

Can I be honest with myself?

If so… then I'll kill myself.

Because… my sin is that I fell in love with him!"

[HERO4]…!?

[HERO4]!!

[HERO4]…!?

[HERO4]!!

I'm home, [HERO2]…

And… Merry Christmas…
Defeat Volfeed!
Defeat Velvet Fury!
[HERO2]… Even if you stay here, [HERO4]…

I know…

But I just want to stay by her side a little longer…
Oh… So, how is it? Any word?

No, nothing…

Even the TDF… hasn't heard anything so far!

I see…

Ah, it's nothing… We're talking about those guys! They'll come home safe and sound before long, right?
I hope you're right…
It bothers me that the space fortress went silent for a while.
Hmm… Maybe they rebooted the power system?
Rebooted? What's that supposed to mean?
They probably needed to restart the main computer for some reason… But what for?
Hmm…
The dimensional distortion field of the Space Fortress Naager has stopped! You can go in any time!

…!?

The dimensional distortion field has stopped?

Well, that's big news! So…

So, what happens now?
It means… that we can storm the space fortress too.

What did you say!?

Then…
Oyassan, please wait for us! I'll bring everyone back safe, I promise.
Yeah, I'm counting on you!
Director! The lead barrier is ready!
Good… Now, even if the worst happens, we can keep the damage to a minimum.

And all of this… depends on him, doesn't it?

No matter how well the barrier protects us, if the Earth itself explodes, it's all for nothing.
Captain Kiriyama… Work with the Science Patrol and MAT, and evacuate as many residents as possible.
No… Evacuate every last one of them! Understood?
Yes, sir!

…!?

Where is this…!?
Steel Emperor Zephas's throne room…!?
Senpai…!
It's the power reactor…
So we just have to smash this thing, right?
But it doesn't look like it'll be that easy…
So that's Steel Emperor Zephas…!?

Heh heh heh… Welcome to my castle…!

I have prepared a welcoming banquet and waited for you!

…!?

Lucifard doesn't seem to be here…? Ku ku ku… Did he get scared and run away?
[HERO2] isn't that kind of guy!

Heh heh heh… Did I strike a nerve?

Well, no matter… This is a rare entertainment! I shall enjoy it thoroughly! I look forward to seeing how many of you remain.
It's you who should worry… I look forward to seeing how many of you vermin remain!
I shall teach you in full what the bioweapons born from Vol cells are like!

…!?

Those are bioweapons…?

These are my lovely EATERs!

Their beauty is not just on the outside! Their cruelty, and their strength too… are truly in the realm of art! Savor the sight of them dancing gracefully!

"EATERs…

What incredible killing intent! There isn't a single opening… Can we win? With just us…"

…!?

Everyone! How did you get here?

U15895: ［殺せない…］ rendered as nested 'I can't kill him…'; 'him' assumed = [HERO2] from context
U15887: 処女が身ごもった rendered with biblical phrasing 'The virgin has conceived' (Christmas parody)
U15890: cryptic poem; 'compete with the blue fairy and win' kept literal
U15913: narration row with only a closing bracket, apparently an off-screen radio report
U15933: Zephas refers to the hero as Lucifard (alias); kept 'Lucifard'/'he'
U15936: 何匹 counts as animals; rendered 'you vermin'
